_comment: Per-machine engine recordings. Each machine can point at one continuous rev recording with "loop" (best: the engine note follows the revs smoothly), or at three fixed-band loops ("idle" / "mid" / "high"). A plain string is shorthand for "loop". Files live in this folder. Any machine without an entry uses the shared /audio/engine_idle.mp3, /audio/engine_mid.mp3 and /audio/engine_high.mp3 loops, pitch-shifted to its own engine note. Keys starting with an underscore are comments and are ignored.
_user_recording: user_engine_loop.mp3 is the player's own recording (copied from the repo root). It is wired to the Cobalt, the first machine in the garage; move the line to another machine id to hear it there, or delete it to fall back to the shared loops.
